svg.title: OmniSense: Privacy-preserving fall detection from ambient WiFi signals, with no cameras or wearables.
svg.desc: Falls detected from WiFi CSI captured by dual ESP32-S3 nodes. Hybrid CNN-BiGRU with a 'Non-Fall' class that suppresses false alarms. 3-phase transfer-learning curriculum bridging lab and low-cost sensors. Edge-to-cloud alerts: MQTT-TLS, AWS IoT Core, SageMaker and Lambda. Stack: Python, PyTorch, ESP32, AWS IoT, SageMaker, Lambda. 93% accuracy, 97% fall precision, <0.5s alert latency.
